name: UNDERWATER_PYRAMID_ACOUSTIC_FINGERPRINT_REVERSE
purpose: Test whether an unknown underwater target can be inferred from measured acoustics without leaking pyramid geometry, scale, 119 Hz, or 520 Hz into the blind-search input.

critical_reverse_correction.finding: fi*L/c is not a first-stage blind feature because L is unknown in the reverse problem.

inverse_steps.input: raw hydrophone channels plus projector reference
inverse_steps.operation: detect stationary repeatable scattering/ringing candidate without geometry labels

inverse_steps.input: known excitation X(f) and received field Y_i(f)
inverse_steps.operation: estimate channel/target transfer functions H_i(f) with propagation and instrument corrections
extract modal peaks, linewidth/Q, ringdown decay, complex phase and aspect dependence
construct scale-free vector before any target-size assumption

inverse_steps.input: blind fingerprint plus preregistered reference library
inverse_steps.operation: jointly score hollow pyramid, solid pyramid, box, cone, irregular rock and natural geological controls across flood/burial states

inverse_steps.input: class/state posterior plus absolute frequencies and CTD c(z)
inverse_steps.operation: infer characteristic scale, orientation, material and state with uncertainty
generate forward predicted underwater transfer function and compare with withheld observed channels/aspects

non_uniqueness_rule: A resonance spectrum alone does not uniquely determine geometry. The reverse output is a posterior over geometry/state/scale/material, not an exact shape declaration. Ambiguity must be retained when multiple controls reproduce the field.

closure_gate.name: JANUS_BACKFORTH_ACOUSTIC_CLOSURE
pass_requires: blind class inference beats matched non-pyramid controls
same inferred class/state repeats on independent passes
forward replay predicts withheld hydrophone/aspect data within preregistered residual tolerance
localization remains stable after CTD correction
fail_if: classification depends on 117-121 or 512-529 Hz prior
only one peak carries the decision
multiple control geometries are statistically indistinguishable
candidate location moves materially when environment model changes within measured uncertainty

field_branch_for_burial.context: If target is beneath thick sediment, direct high-frequency water-column resonance may be inaccessible.
field_branch_for_burial.reverse_input: low-frequency sub-bottom/seismic complex reflections and repeated multi-offset data
field_branch_for_burial.inference_target: coherent impedance geometry and elastic/scattering modes
field_branch_for_burial.rule: Do not apply the simple flooded-cavity 520 Hz prior to a buried target.
